statement.p: A graph of f(x) = \sqrt{25 - (x - 5)^2} is shown above. Using the geometry of the graph, evaluate the definite integrals.

static.solution:
Solution:
Find the signed area, using the graph.
a) Between x = 0 and x = 5, find the area of the quarter-circle with radius r = 5. \int_0^{5} f(x) \, dx = \frac{1}{4} \pi (5)^2 = \dfrac{25 \pi}{4}.
b) Between x = 5 and x = 10, the area under the graph is again a quarter circle of radius r = 5, so \int_{5}^{10} f(x) \, dx = \dfrac{25 \pi}{4}.
c) This is the area of the semi-circle: \int_{0}^{10} f(x) \, dx = \dfrac{25 \pi}{2}.
d) Pull out the constant multiple. \int_{0}^{10} -7 f(x) \, dx = -7 \int_{0}^{10} f(x) \, dx = -7\left( \dfrac{25 \pi}{2}\right).
